description: This file defines a specialized SQLite driver and recordset class for the ADODB database abstraction layer, specifically for the 'sqlitepo' driver which strips table names from returned column fields to avoid conflicts, with some licensing and structural code included.

classes.name: ADODB_sqlitepo
classes.description: A subclass of ADODB_sqlite that modifies behavior for the 'sqlitepo' driver, primarily to adjust how columns are fetched and named.

classes.name: ADORecordset_sqlitepo
classes.description: A subclass of ADORecordset_sqlite that overrides the _fetch method to strip table names from field names in result sets.

methods.name: ADODB_sqlitepo
methods.description: Constructor for ADODB_sqlitepo class, calls parent constructor.

methods.name: ADORecordset_sqlitepo
methods.description: Constructor for ADORecordset_sqlitepo class, calls parent constructor.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches a result row, stripping table names from column identifiers.
